incantations: Kunrinsha yo! Chiniku no kamen, banshō, habataki, hito no na o kansu mono yo! Shinri to sessei, tsumi shiranu yume no kabe ni wazuka ni tsume o tate yo!!

O you who reign! Mask of flesh and blood, all things, beating of wings, you who are crowned with the name of Man! Truth and restraint: on the wall of dreams that knows no sin, sink in your claws, if only a little!
